WITH public_products AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT slug, url, repo_url, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE status IN ('seeded','verified')
  ), source_targets AS (
    SELECT greatest(l.created_at, s.created_at, s.next_attempt_at) AS due_at,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = l.url THEN s.last_success_at END AS success_at,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = l.url THEN s.last_failure_at END AS failure_at,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = l.url THEN s.last_error_code END AS error_code,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = l.url THEN s.state END AS state,
      greatest(l.created_at, s.created_at, s.last_success_at) AS error_since
    FROM public_products p JOIN product_links l ON l.slug = p.slug AND l.visible
    LEFT JOIN product_evidence_sources s ON s.slug = l.slug AND s.kind = l.kind AND s.source_key = l.normalized_key
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL AND s.source_url IS DISTINCT FROM p.url THEN p.updated_at
        ELSE greatest(p.created_at, s.created_at, s.next_attempt_at) END,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = p.url THEN s.last_success_at END,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = p.url THEN s.last_failure_at END,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = p.url THEN s.last_error_code END,
      CASE WHEN s.source_url = p.url THEN s.state END,
      greatest(p.created_at, s.created_at, s.last_success_at)
    FROM public_products p JOIN product_evidence_sources s ON s.slug = p.slug
      AND s.provider = 'product_site' AND s.source_key = 'canonical_site'
  ), agent_inputs AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Avoid parallel sorted finalization over long keys under the database locale.
        SELECT coalesce(CASE WHEN repo_url ~ '^https://github[.]com/[^/]+/[^/#?]+/?$'
    AND right(lower(rtrim(repo_url, '/')), 4) <> '.git'
    THEN lower(rtrim(substring(repo_url from 20), '/')) END, lower(substring(repo_url from '^https://github[.]com/([^/]+/[^/#?]+?)([.]git)?/?$'))) AS repository_key, created_at,
          status NOT IN ('seeded','verified') AS requires_daily
        FROM products WHERE status != 'banned' AND repo_url ~ '^https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/#?]+/?$'
        UNION ALL SELECT lower(repo), updated_at, true FROM crawl_candidates WHERE state IN ('new','needs_review','approved')
      ), agent_demand AS (
        SELECT repository_key, min(created_at) AS created_at, bool_or(requires_daily) AS requires_daily
        FROM agent_inputs GROUP BY repository_key
      ), latest_agent AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.repository_key) s.* FROM agent_repository_scans s JOIN agent_demand d USING (repository_key)
        WHERE scope = '' AND detector_version = $1
        ORDER BY s.repository_key, started_at DESC, id DESC
      ), agent_targets AS (
        SELECT greatest(d.created_at,
          s.next_attempt_at) AS due_at, s.state,
          coalesce(s.last_error_code, CASE WHEN d.repository_key = $2
    AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.started_at <= $3::timestamp) THEN $4 END) AS error_code,
          s.completed_at, CASE WHEN d.repository_key = $5
    AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.started_at <= $6::timestamp) THEN $7::timestamp ELSE s.started_at END AS started_at,
          s.file_count, s.request_count,
          CASE WHEN d.repository_key = $8
    AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.started_at <= $9::timestamp) THEN $10::timestamp
            ELSE greatest(d.created_at, s.completed_at) END AS error_since,
          -- 잡 커서가 기록한 스캔 전 공급자 실패는 저장소별 재시도 대기가 아니다
          coalesce(d.repository_key = $11
    AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.started_at <= $12::timestamp), false) AS job_failure
        FROM agent_demand d LEFT JOIN latest_agent s USING (repository_key)
      ), ai_current AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Avoid one long-key index probe per target when demand cardinality is underestimated.
        SELECT repository_key, rules_version, next_check_at, checked_at, last_error
        FROM repository_ai_levels WHERE rules_version = $13
      ), ai_public AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Reuse normalization across the projection, NULL filter and unseen-idle lookup.
        SELECT coalesce(CASE WHEN repo_url ~ '^https://github[.]com/[^/]+/[^/#?]+/?$'
    AND right(lower(rtrim(repo_url, '/')), 4) <> '.git'
    THEN lower(rtrim(substring(repo_url from 20), '/')) END, substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(rtrim(repo_url, '/')), '^https?://(www[.])?', 'https://'), '[.]git$', '')
        from '^https://github[.]com/([^/]+/[^/#?]+)$')) AS repository_key, created_at FROM public_products
      ), ai_demand AS (
        SELECT repository_key, min(created_at) AS created_at FROM (
          SELECT p.repository_key, p.created_at FROM ai_public p
          LEFT JOIN ai_current seen ON seen.repository_key = p.repository_key
          WHERE NOT $14 OR seen.repository_key IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL SELECT lower(repo), updated_at FROM crawl_candidates
            WHERE state IN ('new','needs_review','approved') AND repo ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$'
        ) d WHERE repository_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY repository_key
      ), ai_targets AS (
        SELECT greatest(d.created_at, r.next_check_at) AS due_at, r.checked_at, r.last_error AS error_code,
          greatest(d.created_at, r.checked_at) AS error_since
        FROM ai_demand d LEFT JOIN ai_current r ON r.repository_key = d.repository_key AND r.rules_version = $15
      )
      SELECT 'evidence' AS key,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $16::timestamp)::int AS waiting,
        extract(epoch FROM ($17::timestamp - min(due_at) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $18::timestamp))) / 60 AS oldest,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE success_at > $19::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND success_at <= $20::timestamp)::int AS completed,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE success_at > $21::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND success_at <= $22::timestamp)::int AS progress,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code <> 'budget_exhausted'
          AND failure_at > $23::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND failure_at <= $24::timestamp)::int AS errors,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at > $25::timestamp AND error_code IS NOT NULL)::int AS deferred,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IN ($26, $27))::int AS provider_errors,
        extract(epoch FROM ($28::timestamp - min(error_since) FILTER (WHERE error_code IN ($29, $30)))) / 60 AS error_age
      FROM source_targets
      UNION ALL SELECT 'agent-evidence', count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $31::timestamp)::int,
        extract(epoch FROM ($32::timestamp - min(due_at) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $33::timestamp))) / 60,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'complete' AND error_code IS NULL AND completed_at > $34::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND completed_at <= $35::timestamp)::int,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('partial','complete') AND error_code IS NULL AND (file_count > 0 OR request_count > 0)
          AND started_at > $36::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND started_at <= $37::timestamp)::int,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code NOT IN ('budget_exhausted','alias_recheck_required')
          AND started_at > $38::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND started_at <= $39::timestamp)::int,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at > $40::timestamp AND (state = 'partial' OR error_code IS NOT NULL))::int,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE job_failure OR error_code IN ($41))::int,
        extract(epoch FROM ($42::timestamp - min(error_since) FILTER (WHERE job_failure OR error_code IN ($43)))) / 60
      FROM agent_targets
      UNION ALL SELECT 'ai-level', count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $44::timestamp)::int,
        extract(epoch FROM ($45::timestamp - min(due_at) FILTER (WHERE due_at <= $46::timestamp))) / 60,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NULL AND checked_at > $47::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND checked_at <= $48::timestamp)::int,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NULL AND checked_at > $49::timestamp - interval '5 minutes' AND checked_at <= $50::timestamp)::int,
        0, count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_at > $51::timestamp AND error_code IS NOT NULL)::int,
        -- Repository absence has a normal 72h recheck; retain its deferred demand without claiming a provider outage.
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code <> 'not_found')::int,
        extract(epoch FROM ($52::timestamp - min(error_since) FILTER (WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code <> 'not_found'))) / 60
      FROM ai_targets
